summary: Frontend smoke test of the Training Room + BYOK 'add key' deep-link CTAs. CORE FEATURE (Training Room): ALL 5 review items pass end-to-end. Login as wayseer -> /workspace. Left rail shows data-testid=nav-training (icon GraduationCap) and clicking it routes to /training and renders [data-testid=page-training]. Run button [data-testid=tr-run-btn] is correctly DISABLED on first render; [data-testid=tr-models-hint] reads 'select at least two teacher models'. [data-testid=tr-add-key-link] renders inside ModelChips (href='/keys') -- the empty-inventory branch IS reachable in the TR load path. Agent dropdown [data-testid=tr-agent-select] lists 5 agents including ToolTester (b1402cb7-...). After selecting an agent, run remains disabled with 0 or 1 custom model; adding 'openai:gpt-4o' via tr-model-custom-input + tr-model-custom-add creates chip [data-testid=tr-model-custom-openai:gpt-4o]; adding 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5' creates the second chip; tr-models-hint disappears and tr-run-btn becomes ENABLED. Prompt counter reads exactly '2 prompt(s) × 2 model(s) = 4 distill step(s)' for the default two-line prompt. Clicking tr-run-btn fires POST /api/instances/{id}/train; backend returns HTTP 200; [data-testid=tr-results-table] renders 4 rows (tr-step-0..3) each with red status text 'no BYOK key for openai/anthropic (teacher_assist...' -- one error row per (prompt × model) as designed. Metrics ribbon [data-testid=tr-metrics] renders with training_step/last_loss/seeds/teachers Stat tiles. NO uncaught console error and NO crash (only the carry-over cosmetic pre-login /api/auth/me 401 noted since iteration_7). CTA PATHS: inv-empty-cta and csf-base-input/csf-base-add-key-link could NOT be live-exercised because GET /api/models/inventory returns 112 public OpenAI/xAI catalog entries (the catalog is BYOK-independent on this build). The empty-state code paths are in place (verified by source read: InventoryPage.jsx L130-137 inv-empty-cta + inv-add-key-btn; CharacterSheetForm.jsx L116-141 csf-*-input + csf-*-add-key-link gated on opts.length===0). TR's own ModelChips empty-branch tr-add-key-link DID render live (confirming the same pattern works for that page; likely TR's useEffect snapshot saw inventory before resolution, or the inventory call resolved empty in that browser session — non-blocking).
action_items: [observation/not-a-bug] The review request assumed `inventory empty` would hold for the `inv-empty-cta` and `csf-base-input` checks because no BYOK keys are configured. But `/api/models/inventory` returns 112 OpenAI/xAI catalog models without any BYOK keys (the catalog enumeration is decoupled from BYOK credentials on this build). Therefore those two empty-state CTAs cannot be exercised live without first clearing the catalog or until inventory truly returns models:[]. The code gating is correct (grep-verified) and iteration_9 had previously confirmed the csf-base-input branch when inventory was empty earlier. RECOMMEND: either (a) document that the catalog is shared/public and `opts.length===0` will only fire on a fresh deploy before the catalog warm-up, or (b) gate inv-empty-cta/csf-* fallback on `inventory.filter(m => m.byok_present).length===0` so the BYOK-empty path is observable while the public catalog stays populated.

[low/observation] Inside TrainingRoom, [data-testid=tr-add-key-link] IS visible on initial mount even though /api/models/inventory returns 112 entries. This is either a render-before-fetch race (useEffect sets inventory after the initial paint) or the api.inventory() call resolved with [] in that session. The default text inputs alongside still let the flow proceed; no functional impact, but worth a sanity check (e.g., always-on hint with a 'inventory has N models' counter or a brief loading state) to avoid confusing UX once a fresh user lands on /training.
[low/carry-over] Pre-login GET /api/auth/me on /login mount still logs a stray 401 in the browser console (also noted in iteration_7/8/9). Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: TrainingRoom.jsx (235 lines) is well-scoped: ModelChips is the only internal component and is purely presentational; state is held in the outer page; api.trainInstance is wrapped in try/catch with a graceful tr-error toast and a refresh of agents (zfae step bump) on success. Good.

TrainingRoom.jsx `ready` gating logic (`agentId && models.length >= 2 && promptList.length >= 1 && !running`) is correct and matches the disabled attribute on tr-run-btn — verified live (disabled with 0 agent / 1 model / empty prompts; enabled only when all 3 conditions met).

Per-step result rendering correctly distinguishes ok vs error rows: error path shows red text + truncated error message (`s.error.slice(0,40)`) — confirmed 'no BYOK key for openai/anthropic (teacher_assist...' in all 4 step rows. Consider expanding the truncated error to show on hover/tooltip (title is already set — works).

The empty-inventory branch in ModelChips (lines 62-67) renders tr-add-key-link inside a hint-only `<span>` rather than as a CTA button — adequate, but a discoverability nit: a brighter chip-styled CTA would scan faster for new BYOK users.

Code-gating for inv-empty-cta (InventoryPage.jsx) still uses `data.count === 0` — the iteration_9 reviewer flagged this as fragile if the backend `count` field is ever missing. Suggest `(data.models?.length ?? 0) === 0` for robustness.

CharacterSheetForm ModelSelect (lines 105-159) `showCustom = customMode || opts.length === 0` is correct. Auto-flip to customMode when `value && opts.length && !opts.includes(value)` handles legacy custom-typed models gracefully — good defensive logic.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 Training Room items PASS; 2/2 CTA items not-exercisable-in-this-env (inventory catalog non-empty by design) — code review confirms wiring

test_credentials: admin wayseer / <redacted> (id 291f2b9d-0949-4059-9c03-c55ecbb72d14). No BYOK provider keys (expected). /api/models/inventory returned 112 public catalog entries (OpenAI/xAI) — note this for next agent.
seed_data_creation: None this iteration. Did NOT clean up the 4 TEST_* agents left over from prior iterations (TEST_ToolsPersist_, TEST_ZfaeNative_, TEST_TeacherTools_, TEST_RegrTeacher_) — they were used as the agent in the Training Room dropdown but no new data was written by this pass besides the one /train call against TEST_ToolsPersist_ which returned all-error steps (no zfae step bump occurs on error). ToolTester remains as documented in the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Training Room is fully functional end-to-end in the BYOK-empty case (graceful per-step 'no BYOK key' errors render in the results table). The inv-empty-cta and csf-base-input/csf-base-add-key-link branches are present in source but did NOT render in this session because /api/models/inventory currently returns 112 public-catalog OpenAI/xAI entries — they would only fire if the catalog were truly empty. If the next agent needs to live-verify those two CTAs, either (a) temporarily mock api.inventory() to return [], or (b) change the gating to BYOK-presence instead of catalog-emptiness. The TR ModelChips tr-add-key-link DID render even with inventory populated upstream — possibly a useEffect race; worth a brief sanity check. Leftover TEST_* agents from earlier iterations should be cleaned up; admin /api/instances response shape is {agents:[...]}.
rca_of_the_issue: Two of the review items (inv-empty-cta + csf-base-add-key-link) could not be live-exercised because the build's /api/models/inventory endpoint returns the public OpenAI+xAI catalog (112 models) without requiring any BYOK API key — so opts.length is never 0 on this deploy. The code paths exist and are correctly wired; only the trigger condition is unreachable in this environment. Recommended fix is to gate the empty-state CTAs on 'no BYOK keys configured' rather than 'catalog empty', so admins see the deep-link to /keys even when a public catalog is available.
